test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom in the given sentence.

__Keep an eye on__ your sister as she might run away.
solution:
The correct answer is __**To watch over attentively .**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• An **Idiom** is a phrase whose meaning differs from the meanings of the words that make it it
 
• The Idiom **Keep an eye on means stay under close scrutiny.**
 
• *Example* : Dealers are **keeping an eye on** the currency markets.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Some more Idioms related to **eye** are :

 
• **Apple of my eye **- It means that someone's favorite person or object when used in reference to family members or those who are closest to us.

*Example* : My daughter is **apple of my eye's.**

 
• **Catch Someone's eye **- It means that something or someone has attracted notice.

*Example* : I tried to catch the** waiter's eye**, so we could order.

 
• **Get a black eye **- This phrase can also be used metaphorically to refer to losing or getting bruise around eye.

*Example* : My father gave me** a black eye.**
